intent_contract.text: 비 오는 밤, 막차가 떠나는 정류장에 혼자 남은 성인이 젖은 서류를 쥔 순간. 지나가던 사람이 급히 찍은 실사 사진. 버스를 놓친 사건과 인물의 낙담이 한 프레임에서 읽히게.
A candid real photograph should show the final bus visibly departing while a solitary adult, holding rain-soaked documents, registers a missed ride and dejection within the same frame.

A hurried, unposed street photograph at a rain-soaked bus stop late at night. One unmistakably adult person stands alone on the pavement beside the shelter, gripping a small stack of wet paper documents in their left hand at waist level, with that elbow loosely bent; the pages sag, stick together, and drip onto the ground. Their feet stay planted beneath their weight and their free arm hangs beside their coat. Their shoulders are slumped, their chin lowered, and tired eyes follow the departing vehicle. The final bus is already pulling away from the stop in the same frame, its rear doors shut and red taillights receding along the empty road. The widening gap between the stranded adult and the moving bus makes the missed ride clear at a glance. Shot by a passerby while moving past, at human height with a slightly tilted frame and a trace of motion blur, using available bus-stop light reflected in wet asphalt. Natural skin and fabric texture, documentary realism, a single fleeting moment.
